# BIOS611 — Clustering assignment

This repo contains code and figures for the BIOS611 clustering assignment (Gap statistic + spectral clustering).

Structure:
- `R/` : R scripts (data generation and analyses)
- `data/` : generated datasets (ignored by git)
- `figures/` : saved plots (ignored by git)
- `docs/` : assignment PDF and notes

Quick start:
1. Install required R packages: `install.packages(c("cluster","ggplot2","plotly"))`
2. Run Task 1 script: `Rscript R/task1_run.R`
3. Run Task 2 script: `Rscript R/task2_run.R`
4. Plots will appear in `figures/`.

Contact: Carmen Martin
